groups.transcript: N: Visitors to the Maritime Museum should note that the audio-guide system has been updated today. Devices are now collected from the information desk rather than the ticket counter. The rental fee remains five dollars, and guests who reserved a guide online may use the express pickup line.

questions.question_text: What change is announced at the museum?

options.text: Audio-guide devices are now collected at the information desk.
The museum entrance has moved to another street.
Audio guides are no longer available for rent.
The ticket counter now closes at noon.

questions.question_text: How much does an audio guide cost to rent?
Who may use the express pickup line?

options.text: Guests who reserved an audio guide online.
Visitors joining the final tour of the day.

groups.transcript: N: This is a service notice for residents of Oak Terrace. Water pressure may be lower than usual on Tuesday while crews replace a valve near Cedar Avenue. Work will begin at eight a.m. and should finish by two p.m. Residents do not need to boil water, but they should avoid running washing machines during the repair period.

questions.question_text: Why may water pressure be lower on Tuesday?

options.text: A new apartment tower is opening.
The city is testing household meters.

questions.question_text: When should the maintenance be completed?
What are residents advised to avoid?

options.text: Running washing machines during the repair.
Drinking tap water after the repair.

groups.transcript: N: Before today’s shift begins, remember that aisle six is temporarily closed while new storage racks are secured. Forklift operators should use aisle eight to reach the north loading dock. The safety inspection is scheduled for eleven-thirty, and aisle six will reopen only after the inspector approves the installation.

questions.question_text: Why is aisle six closed?

options.text: A delivery truck is blocking the aisle.
New storage racks are being secured.

questions.question_text: Which aisle should forklift operators use instead?
What must happen before aisle six reopens?

options.text: An inspector must approve the installation.
The north loading dock must close.

groups.transcript: N: Guests attending tonight’s rooftop jazz reception should check in at the lobby concierge desk. Because rain is expected after nine, the dessert service will move indoors to the Magnolia Ballroom. The music will still begin on the roof at seven-thirty, and umbrellas are available beside the elevator.

questions.question_text: Where should guests check in for the reception?

options.text: Rain is expected later in the evening.
The musicians need the dessert area.

groups.transcript: N: Attention passengers traveling on the 5:05 service to Kingsford. Your train will depart from Platform 12 instead of Platform 9 because of signal testing. The departure time has not changed. Passengers with bicycles should use the rear elevator, which provides the easiest access to Platform 12.

The service will terminate at an earlier station.
Tickets must be reissued before boarding.

options.text: A station event is being held.
An elevator is out of service.

groups.transcript: N: This is a reminder about Thursday’s employee benefits webinar. The session begins at noon and will cover the new dental plan and flexible spending accounts. A link will be emailed to all staff one hour before the webinar. Please submit questions through the human-resources portal by Wednesday at four p.m. so the presenters can address them during the session.

When will staff receive the webinar link?

options.text: At the end of the session.

questions.question_text: What should employees do by Wednesday at four p.m.?

options.text: Submit questions through the human-resources portal.

groups.transcript: N: This weekend at Northgate Appliances, customers who purchase any full-size refrigerator will receive free standard delivery within twenty miles. Our energy-efficient models are displayed near the front entrance, and product specialists will offer short demonstrations every hour from ten a.m. to four p.m. Installation of water lines is available for an additional fee.

options.text: A twenty-percent discount on washing machines.
Free standard delivery with a full-size refrigerator purchase.

What service costs an additional fee?

groups.transcript: N: Students and staff should be aware that Parking Lot D will close at six p.m. Friday for resurfacing. Vehicles left after that time may be moved to the east overflow lot. Lot D is expected to reopen Monday at seven a.m. During the closure, permit holders may use Lots B and C without changing their permits.

options.text: A campus concert will take place there.
A new parking gate will be installed.
The lot will be used for student registration.

What may permit holders do during the closure?

options.text: Park in the east overflow lot for free all semester.
Request a refund for Friday parking.
Use visitor spaces beside the library.
Use Lots B and C with their current permits.

groups.transcript: N: Passengers arriving on Coastal Air Flight 318 from Portland should collect checked baggage at Carousel 6. Oversize items, including skis and large instrument cases, will be delivered to the special-baggage counter beside Carousel 4. If your suitcase has not appeared after twenty minutes, please keep your baggage tag and speak with an agent at the service desk.

groups.transcript: N: Thank you for registering for Saturday’s Riverside Park clean-up. Volunteers will meet at the south picnic shelter at eight-thirty a.m. Gloves and collection bags will be provided, but please bring a refillable water bottle. Because the footbridge is under repair, teams assigned to the east bank will walk there using Harbor Street.

questions.question_text: Where will volunteers meet?

options.text: At the Harbor Street bus stop.

questions.question_text: What should volunteers bring themselves?
Why will some teams use Harbor Street?

options.text: A road race is using the north path.
The east bank is reserved for another event.
